scope: Jeeves discussion backend adaptation: modular API and worker, PostgreSQL authority, private object storage and external email adapter. Plain text, current category access, immutable revisions and durable notifications. Twelve candidate generated rows and eight explicit application hooks; no Discourse parity claim.
excludedScope: Full upstream clone or API compatibility
Application page layout and visual UI composition
Unmeasured production capacity or provider certification
Trust progression, abuse policy, digests, rich text, split/merge, privacy, inbound email and ranking remain hook targets.

conditions: Proposed local engineering target; no measurement or upstream capacity claim.
Suggested reference allocation: 8 logical CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, local SSD; record actual host/container/database limits and fixture seed.
Run one and two API instances with shared authority; use open-loop offered load for 600 seconds after warm-up.
Report scheduled/achieved rate, latency including failures, error rate, queue growth, DB connections and resource use; count expected rejections separately.
Unexpected server failures target <0.1%; never lower frozen targets after a failure. Label undersized profiles separately.
Separate barrier contention: 25 attempts for one stock item, 25 stale updates at one revision, and two deadline workers claiming one batch, where applicable.
Separately labeled recovery run restarts one API and one worker and records unavailable time, backlog recovery and invariants; no infinite stress or live data.

capabilities.description: Register/login/logout/session; protect credentials and mutations; sessions survive API restart and stay isolated from the other applications
Group membership and public/private category grants; a member cannot grant themselves moderator access; cross-scope references fail
Create topic with initial post atomically; rejected post leaves no topic; a lost response and retry create one topic
Reply and edit with immutable revision history; concurrent stale edits conflict; an unauthorized author cannot mutate another post
Close/reopen/archive topic and hide/restore/remove post with allowed transitions; rejected commands leave state unchanged
Apply revocation across detail, list, search, attachment bytes and pending notifications; no title/snippet/count leak through another read path
Watch/mute a topic and set channel preferences; duplicate requests preserve one subscription; another user cannot change it
Durable notification inbox with eligibility recheck and per-recipient deduplication; worker crash/retry cannot duplicate inbox entries
Stage, validate, attach and download files; failed SQL association leaves a recoverable orphan; foreign/private files cannot be attached or fetched
Submit a flag and process its review queue through audited moderator actions; duplicate flags and stale review claims cannot apply an action twice
Bounded topic/post listing and scoped full-text search; stable cursors, authoritative access filtering, projection rebuild and deletion visibility
Content removal/tombstones and audit history; removed text stays absent from ordinary history/search; repeated removal is safe
Trust-level progression from recorded activity; fixture defines promote/demote thresholds and privileged overrides without trusting client activity counters
Abuse/spam adjudication policy; false-positive appeal and moderator override are explicit, while generic request limits remain infrastructure
Digest selection and scheduling; exclude muted/inaccessible content and define timezone/window behavior and duplicate delivery policy
Rich-text rendering and mention extraction; sanitize output, bound parsing and suppress inaccessible-recipient notifications
Topic split/merge; preserve post identity/history, access decisions, subscription behavior and failure recovery
Account export/erasure policy; define retained audit, removed identity/content, queued delivery cancellation and legal-hold exceptions
Inbound email-to-reply integration; authenticate source, identify topic, deduplicate message IDs and reject unauthorized posting
Discovery/ranking strategy; deterministic tie-breaks, visibility enforcement and explicit freshness/rebuild semantics
